
---

### Download

| File | |
|---|---|
| `Kladde_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe` | Installer for the current user, no admin rights needed |
| `Kladde_{{VERSION}}_x64_portable.exe` | Runs without installing |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums |
| `latest.json`, `…-setup.exe.sig` | Signed update data for Kladde's built-in update check |

Kladde needs Windows 10 or 11 with WebView2, which ships with Windows 11. The files are not code-signed yet, so
Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on the first start.
